author: Tpak
body: I have been banned for hacking, I have already made an appeal; it got denied. I will explain the full story: My friend Liam came round to my house, I let him go on minecraft whilst I had to get changed, washed and brush my teeth for bed (since he was staying the night.) I didn't notice he was using hacks, but I imagined he was using 1.8 optifine. Then I was on my tablet watching YouTube with my headphones plugged in. Then he said to me "Billy, I got banned of the server." (granted, he was only 9.) I was very frustrated, and then I learnt that hacking was really bad, so I deleted my hacks (The only reason I have hacks is because my friend Kyle told me to download them, so I got them, and we kept on pranking our other friend Hubert on his server, I got banned of his server, temperarily, and then I exited out of minecraft, next time it was opened, Liam was on it. So that is why he had hacks on, on Avicus.) I hope you understand that it was not all my fault and that I hope you can unabn me so I can play with my friend Alf (IGN: Alfs).
